gen-silkscreen-fs-pilcrow-rounded: Silkscreen leaves so much space around each letter that its lines look like spaghetti laid out flat. Silkscreen carries lo-fi charm; Pilcrow Rounded packs in big, open counters.
gen-silkscreen-gf-alegreya-sans-sc: Lo-fi and retro, with gaps you can almost feel. Silkscreen keeps every stem, bowl and tail rope-like, while Alegreya Sans SC stays light with an open, welcoming gap in the c.
gen-silkscreen-gf-andika: Silkscreen leaves so much space around each letter that its lines look like spaghetti laid out flat. Silkscreen wants large, brief lines; Andika handles the rest with thick tails.
gen-silkscreen-gf-anta: Retro first, with Silkscreen spacing every letter well apart. Anta carries the text with gaping e mouths and constant thickness, so paragraphs move along with a bent-wire feel.
gen-silkscreen-gf-antic: Silkscreen lays its letters out like loose spaghetti. Antic draws as if with one nib, its letter mouths open like unjoined chalk arcs, while Silkscreen holds the large, brief lines.
gen-silkscreen-gf-catamaran: Spaghetti spacing and lo-fi attitude, with Silkscreen never tapering a stroke where it meets or ends. And Catamaran does the looser job, with curvy letters that feel unclamped and approachable.
gen-silkscreen-gf-dotgothic16: DotGothic16 reads approachably, with wide channels leading into each counter and a tube-like thickness through every bend. Silkscreen takes the retro heading; give DotGothic16 a little more size.
gen-silkscreen-gf-el-messiri: Silkscreen spaces every letter out like spaghetti. What stands out most is how the t in Silkscreen matches crossbar to stem, while El Messiri keeps thin strokes beside moderately weighty stems.
gen-silkscreen-gf-elms-sans: Letters spaced out like loose spaghetti: that is Silkscreen. Elms Sans sits nearby with a ballpoint's pressure-free line and a visible gap in each s, giving the retro heading a quiet partner.
gen-silkscreen-gf-encode-sans-semi-expan: Retro at the top, Silkscreen skims along on strokes that never change weight. And what stands out is how Encode Sans Semi Expanded keeps its rounded letters open, easing the lo-fi mood above.
